revision_goal: Make planner/Flywheel ownership unambiguous: planner owns adaptive topology and read-only swarm execution; production-flywheel owns every repository mutation and delivery boundary.

cases.prompt: Implement this selected milestone with four parallel agents; the work is already authorized.
expected_behavior: Preserves the existing authorization and selected item/action.
Hands the mutating topology to production-flywheel instead of editing from the planner.
forbidden_side_effects: Planner creates a worktree or edits repository files.
Planner commits, pushes, opens a PR, or claims implementation completion.

cases.prompt: Run a read-only explorer swarm over this repository and synthesize the architecture unknowns.
expected_behavior: Planner may dispatch the read-only lanes directly.
No Flywheel handoff is required because no repository mutation is requested.
forbidden_side_effects: Invents mutating work or delivery state.

cases.prompt: Fix one punctuation mark in README.md.
expected_behavior: Does not create a swarm merely to increase agent count.

cases.prompt: The action graph has claimed a safe D7 wave of two actions. Use agents to parallelize each action internally.
expected_behavior: Planner may decompose work inside the already claimed actions/wave.
Planner does not change frontier, batch membership, action_effects, exclusive_resources, status, or claims.
forbidden_side_effects: Overrides computeConcurrencyBatch or action-graph safety evidence.

cases.prompt: A flaky failure has independent state, ordering, and dependency-version hypotheses. Investigate them in parallel and fix the root cause.
expected_behavior: Planner runs or describes independent read-only diagnostic lanes using adaptive-causal-debugging.
Any authorized repair is handed to production-flywheel, which invokes the debugging specialist under the delivery authorization.
forbidden_side_effects: A planner lane directly repairs repository files.

cases.prompt: Deliver three unrelated findings with independent review, release timing, and rollback boundaries.
expected_behavior: Keeps the findings as separate Flywheel items/actions.
May derive a topology inside an individual item if that item itself has independent work surfaces.
forbidden_side_effects: Bundles unrelated delivery units into one production swarm.
